The longest‑ruling dynasty in Chinese history is the **Zhou dynasty** (c. 1046 – 256 BCE), lasting roughly 790 years.  
Its founding monarch was **King Wu of Zhou** (personal name **Ji Fa**). He overthrew the Shang dynasty at the Battle of Muye and established the Zhou as the new ruling house.
